title: Burst Balloons
description:
# Burst Balloons

You are given `n` balloons, indexed from `0` to `n - 1`. Each balloon is painted with a number on it represented by an array `nums`. You are asked to burst all the balloons.

If you burst the `i`-th balloon, you will get `nums[i - 1] * nums[i] * nums[i + 1]` coins. If `i - 1` or `i + 1` goes out of bounds of the array, then treat it as if there is a balloon with a `1` painted on it.

Return *the maximum coins you can collect by bursting the balloons wisely*.

## Example 1:

**Input:** nums = [3,1,5,8]
**Output:** 167
**Explanation:**
nums = [3,1,5,8] --> [3,5,8] --> [3,8] --> [8] --> []
coins =  3*1*5    +   3*5*8   +  1*3*8  + 1*8*1 = 167

## Example 2:

**Input:** nums = [1,5]
**Output:** 10

## Constraints:

*   `n == nums.length`
*   `1 <= n <= 300`
*   `0 <= nums[i] <= 100`

solutions.name: Bottom-Up Interval DP
solutions.description: Pad the array with 1s on both ends. Use interval DP where dp[left][right] is the max coins from bursting all balloons in [left, right]. For each interval, try every balloon k as the last one to burst.

solutions.name: Top-Down Memoization
solutions.description: Pad the array with 1s on both ends. Use recursion with memoization where solve(left, right) returns the max coins from bursting all balloons strictly between left and right. For each k in (left, right), try k as the last balloon to burst.
